recentItems.title: Portfolio Committees on Home Affairs, 25 August 2026
recentItems.description:
(National Assembly), [Briefing by the Department of Home
Affairs and Border Management Authority on the
detailed financial report of the repatriation and
deportation expenditure and the procurement
process/virement. Briefing Department of Home Affairs
on matters pertaining to the budget and tools of trade
allocated to the Standing Committee for Refugee Affairs
(SCRA) and the Refugee Appeals Authority of South
Africa (RAASA), including human resources. A
comprehensive briefing by the Department of Home
Affairs on immigration processes relating to applications
by foreign nationals for permits and visas, including
current backlogs and measures being implemented to
eradicate such backlogs.], Virtual Meeting Platform,
09:00 – 13:00
